replay.environment_variable_value:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from math import log, sqrt
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import sys

import numpy as np
import scipy

root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "scripts"))
from verify_spatial_repair import exact_failure_times
from purposeful.spatial_repair import SpatialRepair

source_paths = [
    "src/purposeful/spatial_repair.py",
    "scripts/verify_spatial_repair.py",
    "tests/test_spatial_repair.py",
]
source_hashes = {path: sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in source_paths}
input_path = root / "results/spatial-repair.json"
formal_path = root / "results/spatial-repair-verification.json"
input_bytes = input_path.read_bytes()
input_hash = sha256(input_bytes).hexdigest()
formal_bytes = formal_path.read_bytes()
formal_hash = sha256(formal_bytes).hexdigest()
study = json.loads(input_bytes)
formal = json.loads(formal_bytes)
if formal["input_sha256"] != input_hash or not formal["passed"]:
    raise RuntimeError("The formal verification must pass for the same data")
for path, digest in source_hashes.items():
    if formal["source_sha256"][path] != digest:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Source no longer matches the formal verification: {path}")
model = SpatialRepair(**study["parameters"])
times = np.asarray(study["times"])
grid = study["refinements"][-1]
spatial = grid["initial_conditions"]["HD"]["spatial"]
n_paths = 100_000
cases = [("localized", 2026111717), ("reaction", 2026111718)]
alpha = 0.01
dkw = sqrt(log(2 * len(cases) / alpha) / (2 * n_paths))
reports = []
for preparation, seed in cases:
    failures, events = exact_failure_times(model, preparation, (1, model.fuel), float(times[-1]), n_paths, seed)
    surviving = n_paths - np.searchsorted(np.sort(failures), times, side="right")
    estimate = surviving / n_paths
    residual = estimate - spatial[preparation]
    j = int(np.argmax(np.abs(residual)))
    reports.append({
        "chemistry": "HD",
        "initial_fuel": model.fuel,
        "preparation": preparation,
        "seed": seed,
        "paths": n_paths,
        "surviving_paths": surviving.tolist(),
        "empirical_survival": estimate.tolist(),
        "maximum_absolute_discrepancy": float(np.abs(residual[j])),
        "signed_discrepancy_at_maximum": float(residual[j]),
        "time_at_maximum_discrepancy": float(times[j]),
        "sampled_root_mean_square_discrepancy": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(residual**2))),
        "within_familywise_dkw_band": bool(np.abs(residual[j]) <= dkw),
        "events": events,
    })
if sha256(input_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != input_hash or sha256(formal_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != formal_hash:
    raise RuntimeError("A data receipt changed during the supplemental check")
if any(sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest for path, digest in source_hashes.items()):
    raise RuntimeError("A computation source changed during the supplemental check")
record = {
    "generated_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "scope": "Supplemental repeat-seed check of the existing continuous-path sampler for the HD localized and gate-weighted preparations. This does not replace or add cases to the formal four-preparation verification receipt.",
    "method": "Sample the first entry into double damage under wrapped Brownian motion with state-wise bounded candidate-event thinning. Compare empirical survival on the supplied reporting grid with the finest periodic lattice at the same launch. Right-censor at the reporting horizon.",
    "environment": {"python": platform.python_version(), "numpy": np.__version__, "scipy": scipy.__version__},
    "replay": {
        "shell": "PowerShell",
        "working_directory": "repository root",
        "command": "python -B -c \"import os; exec(os.environ['SPATIAL_REPAIR_REVIEW_PROGRAM'])\"",
        "environment_variable": "SPATIAL_REPAIR_REVIEW_PROGRAM",
        "environment_variable_value": os.environ["SPATIAL_REPAIR_REVIEW_PROGRAM"],
    },
    "input_path": "results/spatial-repair.json",
    "input_sha256": input_hash,
    "formal_verification_path": "results/spatial-repair-verification.json",
    "formal_verification_sha256": formal_hash,
    "source_sha256": source_hashes,
    "lattice_points_per_axis": grid["n"],
    "horizon": float(times[-1]),
    "times": times.tolist(),
    "paths_total": n_paths * len(cases),
    "simultaneous_confidence": 1 - alpha,
    "dkw_half_width": dkw,
    "all_cases_within_familywise_dkw_band": all(case["within_familywise_dkw_band"] for case in reports),
    "cases": reports,
}
output = root / "results/spatial-repair-review-check.json"
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
for case in reports:
    print(case["preparation"], case["signed_discrepancy_at_maximum"], case["time_at_maximum_discrepancy"], case["events"]["maximum_energy_ledger_residual"])
print("Two-case 99% DKW half-width:", dkw)
print(output.relative_to(root))
